title: Faure Bardon et al. 2020 open-circuit term-cotyledon letermovir, maribavir, and antipyrine observations
citation: Faure Bardon V, Peytavin G, Lê MP, Guilleminot T, Elefant E, Stirnemann J, Leruez-Ville M, Ville Y. Placental transfer of Letermovir & Maribavir in the ex vivo human cotyledon perfusion model. PLoS ONE. 2020;15(4):e0232140. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0232140.
license: Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY), as stated by the publisher article.

observation_frame.record_unit: One published worksheet cell for one analyte, measurement, placenta label, and perfusion timepoint. Repeated values remain linked by the workbook’s source label and study-drug group.
observation_frame.source_label_caution: Placenta labels are table identifiers, not donor IDs. The inspected source supplies no donor identity key; do not assert personal identities, cross-study links, or independence beyond the source-reported perfusion labels.

measured_fields.name: fetal_to_maternal_ratio
measured_fields.source_formula: FC / MC where shown in the source; preserve direct values, formulas, and cached results independently.

included_analytes: antipyrine (validation marker, linked to its study-drug group and placenta label)

missingness.source_blank_pattern: All fetal-concentration cells at 0 min are blank for the eight labels in both the study-drug and antipyrine sections (16 blank scalar rows). Blanks remain blank. Any source FTR formula/cache at 0 min remains a ratio record and does not fill a concentration cell.

formula_and_cache_provenance.method: The original XLSX is pinned unmodified. Each CSV row stores the exact source cell value lexeme; ordinary formulas and shared-formula group metadata are retained, and formula cells retain the embedded cached-result lexeme. No formula was recalculated to populate the CSV.
formula_and_cache_provenance.validation: Cycle 233 bounded raw-XML audit matched all 912 mapped values and complete ordinary/shared formula metadata and caches. It found 304 formula cells in the mapped source rows, including 259 shared-formula followers without local formula text; all group identifiers/ranges/master cells and cached values are now retained. Paired source FTR values were checked against FC/MC. Summary formulas remain separately documented.

summary_table_review.status: unresolved source-scope discrepancy; candidate remains pending human review
summary_table_review.maribavir: The workbook has three visible source labels; 224 populated group-summary cells across the active-drug and antipyrine tables reproduce from those three labels.
summary_table_review.letermovir: The workbook has five visible source labels, but group mean/SD entries use only Placenta 1–4. All source formula references inspected point to those four labels; 224 populated group-summary values reproduce from Placenta 1–4. Including all five visible labels changes 220 of those 224 summary values.
summary_table_review.handling: Retain all five raw letermovir series and the original workbook summary formulas/values. Do not infer validation or exclude a source label, and do not recompute an alternative aggregate. See Cycle 234 receipt.

primary_article_crosscheck.validated_counts_and_locator: PLOS Results reports 5 of 10 LMV and 3 of 8 MBV perfusions validated; mean antipyrine FTR values are 31±2% and 21±1%.
primary_article_crosscheck.published_table3_denominator: Table 3 gives group means±SD but no printed group n or label-to-summary crosswalk.
primary_article_crosscheck.resolved_status: unresolved; the primary article does not identify which S1 labels contribute to the five validated LMV procedures.

cycle236_pointwise_antipyrine_diagnostic.interpretation: Pointwise diagnostic only; the article does not specify that the 30-minute row alone determines per-run validation. It does not resolve the label mismatch.

cycle238_chart_crosscheck.interpretation: Chart reproduces the same four-label summary; it supplies no independent label crosswalk.

cycle239_workbook_structure_screen.finding: No hidden-state or range metadata explains the four-label formula scope; author intent remains unknown.

source_quality_notes: The source contains an antipyrine maternal concentration of 113 mg/L at Z40 (Letermovir group, Placenta 3, 80 min). Preserve it exactly; do not exclude or correct it before source review.

The workbook includes summary columns and charts; the CSV is a source-cell intake of individual-label FC, MC, and FTR entries only. Summary values remain available in the pinned workbook and are documented in summary_table_review.
article_context: The article describes open-circuit term-cotyledon perfusions, maternal/fetal sampling every 5 minutes over 90 minutes, antipyrine as a validation marker, and an antipyrine FTR >20% criterion. It reports 10 letermovir perfusions with 5 validated and 8 maribavir perfusions with 3 validated. S1 Data has active-drug and antipyrine FC/MC/FTR source-label trajectories plus summary columns. The inspected files do not provide numeric reservoir-volume or sample-removal histories, individual recovery/mass-balance rows, or individual tissue-concentration observations.

eligibility.eligible_for: Source-linked descriptive term-placenta concentration and source-ratio trajectories, pending human transcription review and resolution or explicit retention of the letermovir summary-label discrepancy.
not_eligible_for: net flux or dimensional transfer-parameter fitting
embryo development, gestation, birth, or health outcome inference
missing_records: donor identifiers and an explicit validated-label crosswalk

scope_limits: This is ex vivo term-placenta transfer evidence, not embryo growth or an artificial-womb performance result.
Placenta labels are source identifiers, not personal identities; no same-donor relationship to another study is established.
Do not pool with the distinct 2016 Schalkwijk, 2019 Mandelbrot, 2021 Le, 2022 Bukkems, or 2020 Mathiesen datasets.
Source transcription and scientific review remain pending; no author was contacted.

independent_source_reconciliation.cycle233_correction: Added explicit ordinary/shared formula type, shared group/index/range/master-cell fields, and cached values for all 304 mapped formulas.
independent_source_reconciliation.status: all 912 mapped values and formula/cache metadata now match the pinned XLSX; 0 mismatches
independent_source_reconciliation.ratio_check: 288 paired FC/MC/FTR records recompute within absolute tolerance 1e-5; 0 mismatches
independent_source_reconciliation.eligibility_effect: supports descriptive concentration/ratio trajectories only; pending human review and volume/removal, recovery, donor-key and letermovir-summary limitations remain
